info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Status API provides real-time updates on the status of prescriptions within the pharmacy system. This endpoint enables users to retrieve current status information for ongoing prescriptions, ensuring that both pharmacy staff and patients are informed about the fulfillment process. Typical consumers of this API include pharmacy management systems, healthcare providers, and patients seeking to track their medication orders. By offering timely insights into prescription status, the API supports enhanced communication and operational efficiency within healthcare practices.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of prescriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the status of prescriptions for patients. It provides insights into whether prescriptions are active, pending, or expired, enabling better management of patient medication.
